title: Bawan Hikima Mai Ɓoyayyen Hikima
intro: A cikin tarin labaran Alƙur'ani mai girma, akwai wani mutum mai ban mamaki, bawan Allah mai ilimi da rahamar Allah. Wannan mutum mai ban mamaki ya haɗu da ɗaya daga cikin manyan annabawa, wanda ya kai ga tafiya cike da ayyuka masu rikitarwa waɗanda suka ƙalubalanci iyakokin fahimtar ɗan adam. Kowane aiki, duk da cewa yana kama da rashin adalci, ya ɓoye darussa masu zurfi game da ƙaddara, haƙuri, da hikimar da ba a gani a bayan ƙaddarar Allah. Wanene wannan mutum mai duhu, kuma waɗanne gaskiya ne suka bayyana?
clues: Ni bawan Allah ne, an zaɓe ni don ilimi da rahama na musamman.
Wani babban annabi ya nemi ya koya daga gare ni, kuma na yarda a ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗa masu tsauri.
A lokacin taronmu, na yi ayyuka uku da suka yi kama da marasa adalci ga abokin aikina.
Na lalata wani jirgin ruwa mallakar talakawa, duk da haka rahama ce ta ɓoye.
Na kashe wani ƙaramin yaro, duk da cewa abin ya yi kama da mugunta, amma don ya ceci ran iyayensa ne.
Na sake gina wani katanga a wani gari da ya hana mu karɓar baƙi, inda na bayyana wata taska a ƙarƙashinsa.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
